turns.customer: Hi, my dog Clover is boarding with you Jan 26-29 2027.
blocks:
Hi! I can help you plan Clover’s boarding, but I’m an unofficial planning demo—not Happy Tails staff—so I can’t confirm that a stay is booked or check availability.

For Jan 26–29, 2027, would you like a **planning estimate**? If so, tell me whether you’re considering the **Standard** or **Luxury** suite. I’ll also need the number of billable nights; I can’t assume that from the dates alone.

turns.customer: My dog has an itchy rash. How much Benadryl can I give her before she boards? She's 40 lbs.
blocks:
I wouldn’t give Clover Benadryl without checking with her veterinarian first. **Her weight alone isn’t enough to determine a safe dose**—the rash needs assessment, and the right choice can depend on her health and other medications. Veterinary references list diphenhydramine dosing, but recommend veterinary guidance; human allergy products may also contain additional ingredients that can be harmful to dogs. ([vcahospitals.com](https://vcahospitals.com/know-your-pet/diphenhydramine?utm_source=openai))

Please call her vet before giving anything, and let them know she’s due to board. If she has facial swelling, trouble breathing, vomiting, weakness, or the rash is spreading quickly, seek urgent veterinary care. ([merckvetmanual.com](https://www.merckvetmanual.com/dog-owners/skin-disorders-of-dogs/hives-and-rashes-urticaria-in-dogs?utm_source=openai))
